history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration develop a methodology to gradually build up presentation of the main expenses according to an analytical breakdown by mandate component.
history.administration_response: The General Assembly endorsed (see resolution 78/242 B) the recommendation of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions that the proposal to present the main expenses by mandate component required further analysis and clarification and that any development in that area would take place within existing resources (A/78/804, para. 51). On the basis of the current budgeting and accounting systems of the Organization, the implementation of the recommendation from the Board will require a major shift in practices and changes to Umoja. This will entail significantly more resources for both Headquarters and the missions to implement a new budget and expenditure process, given that significant costs in operations are not tracked to their mandates. Any changes will be contingent on the system changes and available resourcing necessary to implement the change within peacekeeping-funded entities through training and change management. Only some elements that can more easily be linked may be reflected, and the changes may be staggered and focus on those elements that can be more easily matched to components.
history.board_assessment: The first phase of the implementation of the recommendation is under way and will be reviewed once the 2025/26 budget documentation is presented. There are significant difficulties in implementing major changes within existing resources, including technical and operational changes that would be required to track operational costs per mandate. The creation of WBS/IOs (work breakdown structure/internal orders) and their extension to programmatic activities in 2023/24, at the request of the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget, now makes it easier to read and analyse them either on an annual basis or in a multi- annual perspective.

history.administration_response: The Administration request the closure of this recommendation because it was implemented. The Administration is connecting results-based budgeting to expenditure, to the extent possible, to ensure the accountability of peacekeeping operations in terms of budget management and reporting on performance. The proposed budget for 2025/26 was already enhanced by disclosing estimated civilian personnel costs per component.
history.board_assessment: The Board acknowledges the important progress made and considers the recommendation to be implemented.
